title: Doesn't work with oil
text: Doesn't work with oil. I had high hopes for this product, but I was disappointed.  I bought it specifically for spraying olive oil.  Before using it, I cleaned it with arm soapy water, then let it dry.  I then tried it out with water first.  I had no problems.  Then I used a funnel to fill it with my oil and tried it again.  Nothing came out.  I squeezed the trigger - it was hard to pull.  Still nothing came out.  Apparently the oil is too thick to pass through this sprayer.  I don't recommend this product for spraying oil, at all.  It failed miserably in doing that.
